data_migration.notes: No migration. v1 may append repository-local proposal and human-review records only; it does not rewrite outcome, regression, Skill, lifecycle, or adjacent-repository history.

risks: SIMULATED_ONLY outcome evidence could be mistaken for external business or user success
A generated learning proposal could be mistaken for Skill promotion authority
A model or automation could attempt to approve its own proposal
Regression thresholds or rollback references could drift from their immutable governed inputs
Private prompts, credentials, customer data, provider payloads, or repository bodies could leak into proposal records
A future adapter could widen the boundary into RTS-Skills or another adjacent repository without a new approval gate
external_interfaces: None in v1; read-only access to committed RTS outcome, regression, Asset Manifest, FREEZER, and schema records
Repository-local append-only proposal and human-review records only

No network, subprocess, shell, provider API, GitHub write outside the implementation PR, Skill mutation, adjacent-repository write, deployment, publication, messaging, scheduling, customer action, or automatic rollback
regression_tests: proposal package verify command fails closed on stale fingerprints, missing evidence, privacy-sensitive keys, self-approval, or adjacent-repository authority
deterministic proposal generation produces byte-equivalent canonical records for identical governed inputs
human-review records cannot be authored or approved by the proposal generator identity
approval_changes: This Preflight records implementation readiness only; RTS-FRZ-000007 remains FROZEN / NOT_APPROVED
A separate explicit human lifecycle revision is required before SELECTED or IN_PROGRESS
v1 may create recommendations and review records but cannot approve, apply, publish, promote, retire, mutate, or roll back a Skill
Any future adjacent-repository mutation, real-world outcome ingestion, or promotion application requires a new Assessment, Preflight, and human approval
existing_assumptions: RTS-FRZ-000004 through RTS-FRZ-000006 are COMPLETED on main
RTS-BA-000007-002 is current and recommends BUILD_NOW
outcome_evidence contains at least three privacy-safe governed SIMULATED_ONLY bundles and permanently marks them NOT_ELIGIBLE for promotion
skill_regression contains pinned baseline and candidate fixtures, zero-regression thresholds, and an immutable rollback snapshot
The current RTS-Skills promotion-review manifest is reference-only and grants no implementation or mutation authority
Python standard library and repository-local deterministic processing are sufficient for v1
WIP=1 is currently available but is not consumed by this Preflight-only change
public_documents: future proposal-only v1 README and schemas created only after explicit lifecycle approval
rationale: The implementation ground is now sufficiently bounded for a proposal-only v1. It can deterministically read committed governed outcome and regression evidence, emit local immutable learning proposals linked to exact fingerprints, and support a separately authored human review record. It cannot treat simulated evidence as external success, approve its own output, change Skill content, write to adjacent repositories, publish, execute external actions, or apply rollback. Those exclusions keep promotion authority outside the implementation and preserve human control.
affected_boundaries: new repository-local proposal-only package, schemas, fixtures, verifier, CLI, README, and focused tests
read-only outcome_evidence input and evidence-classification boundary
read-only skill_regression baseline, candidate, threshold, result, and rollback-snapshot boundary
Asset Manifest references to canonical outcome verification, regression, and promotion-review contracts
FREEZER Assessment, Preflight, lifecycle, WIP=1, indexes, and manifest boundary
canonical execution_record and evidence_ref linkage boundary for reconstructable proposal provenance
governed CI path filters and semantic freshness verification
rollback_boundary: Revert only the future proposal-only implementation PR and its append-only RTS-local records before any separate promotion decision. The pinned RTS-Skills baseline, immutable rollback snapshot, outcome corpus, regression dataset, adjacent repositories, external services, credentials, provider state, deployment, publication, messages, schedules, customer state, and real Skills remain unchanged by v1.
hidden_dependencies: Assessment and Preflight fingerprints must remain current for the substantive item plan
The proposal generator identity must be distinct from the human reviewer identity and must never emit an approved decision
Every proposal must pin exact outcome bundle, evidence, baseline, candidate, regression-result, threshold, and rollback-snapshot fingerprints
All consumed outcome classifications must preserve VERIFIED, UNVERIFIED, ASSUMED, and SIMULATED_ONLY semantics without promotion overclaim
Manifest hashes and semantic indexes must be regenerated after governed record changes
WIP=1 must hold before any later SELECTED or IN_PROGRESS transition
No proposal may name an adjacent-repository write, Skill mutation, publication, or external action as an executable capability
completion_conditions: Identical governed inputs generate the same canonical proposal identifier, content fingerprint, evidence references, and recommendation
Only current verified outcome bundles and a current passing regression result may be referenced
Every proposal separates confirmed facts, assumptions, unverified claims, risks, and exact evidence references
SIMULATED_ONLY inputs can support only bounded local recommendations and never external success claims
Every proposal references the immutable rollback snapshot and the exact baseline and candidate fingerprints
Proposal status is proposal-only and defaults to NOT_APPROVED / NOT_APPLIED
The generator cannot create an APPROVED decision or act as the human reviewer
Human review records are append-only, identity-explicit, and do not mutate or publish a Skill
No network, provider, subprocess, shell, adjacent-repository write, Skill mutation, deployment, publication, messaging, scheduling, customer action, or automatic rollback exists
Privacy-sensitive keys, path escape, raw prompts, credentials, customer data, provider payloads, and repository bodies are rejected
All proposal, regression, outcome, FREEZER, Asset Manifest, controller, loop, unit, stale-index, and Unicode checks pass
RTS-FRZ-000007 remains FROZEN / NOT_APPROVED until a separate explicit human lifecycle revision
